notes: All sources are proposed grammar probes, not verified runnable programs. SM02 requires additional real guest driver; SM03 requires a separate negative fixture; SM15 requires lexical/parser/formatter execution. Inline source is exact UTF-8 with LF; do not rewrite candidate syntax per backend.

Every profile and case remains NOT_EXECUTED. A host model, source parser, skipped job, unsupported target or test stub cannot count as compiled guest evidence. Unsupported profile must be reported separately with refusal before artifact.
SM12 and SM21–SM25 depend on the retry/undo contract; do not implement a second divergent ledger.
